skill.name: art-style-creator
skill.description: Create and define visual art styles for projects. Use when user wants to establish an art direction, create a style guide, define visual language, document aesthetic choices, or create consistent artwork guidelines for games, illustrations, animations, or other visual media.
skill.summary: Build structured art style guides for visual projects.
skill.author: CesarAugustusGroB

content.value_statement: Visual projects lose consistency when colors, shapes, lighting, and texture are undocumented. This skill turns art direction decisions into a structured style guide.
actual_capabilities: Guides project context, target audience, vision statements, keywords, and influences.
Defines palette roles, forbidden colors, and color usage rules using color theory guidance.
Documents line work, shape language, composition, lighting, texture, mood, and tone.
Produces a Markdown art style guide template with technical specifications.
Provides genre presets for anime, cartoon, realistic, pixel art, noir, fantasy, sci-fi, horror, and minimalist styles.
limitations: It does not generate finished artwork or image assets.
It needs project goals, audience details, and references for specific guidance.
It does not verify copyright or licensing status for named influences.
It does not replace production review by an art director or lead designer.

use_cases.title: Game Art Direction
use_cases.description: Create shared rules for characters, environments, UI elements, lighting, and asset sizes before production starts.

use_cases.title: Illustration Series Planning
use_cases.description: Define palettes, line quality, texture, and mood so multiple illustrations feel like one collection.

use_cases.title: Brand Visual Exploration
use_cases.description: Translate a concept into a visual language with shape rules, color hierarchy, and reference influences.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Style Guide
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new visual project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create an art style guide for a [project type]. The audience is [target audience]. The mood should feel [mood words].

prompt_templates.title: Refine Palette and Mood
prompt_templates.prompt: Define a color palette, forbidden colors, mood rules, and lighting direction for a project that should feel [emotion] and avoid [unwanted tone].

prompt_templates.title: Build Production Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed production guidance for a team.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create production-ready art rules for characters, environments, UI, texture, detail distribution, and export specs for [project name].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Complete Style Bible
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a complete art style guide with vision, influences, palette, line work, shapes, composition, lighting, texture, mood, technical specs, and do and do not rules.

output_examples.input: A cozy farming game for teens with friendly characters and low stress gameplay.
output_examples.output: A warm analogous palette, rounded shape language, soft lighting, low texture detail, and clear asset size guidance.

output_examples.input: A sci-fi dashboard UI for a tactical strategy game.
output_examples.output: A cool palette with neon accents, clean geometric lines, modular layouts, artificial lighting, and strict icon specifications.

output_examples.input: A fantasy illustration series needs consistent character and environment rules.
output_examples.output: A guide with rich color rules, organic silhouettes, dramatic lighting, painterly texture, and reference influence notes.

best_practices: Provide project type, audience, tone, and reference influences before asking for the guide.
Review palette, line, shape, and lighting rules together because they affect each other.
Add technical constraints such as resolution, file formats, and asset dimensions early.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a finished image when you need a style specification.
Do not copy a named artist or studio without adapting the influence into original rules.
Do not skip forbidden colors, mood breakers, or do and do not guidance.

faq.question: Does this skill create images?
faq.answer: No. It creates written art direction and style guide content for later production.

faq.question: Can it support game art pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes characters, environments, UI elements, asset sizes, and export specifications.

faq.question: Can I use it for branding work?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define visual language, palettes, shape rules, and reference influences for brand exploration.

faq.question: Does it include color theory guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It references palette types, color psychology, saturation, value, and construction rules.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the project type, audience, mood, keywords, references, and any technical constraints.

faq.question: Does it check legal use of references?
faq.answer: No. You must review copyright, trademarks, and licensing before using named references in production.
